overall_finding: Preserve the repository's integrity and isolation controls; prioritize cross-domain claim-level evaluation, judge calibration, rolling untouched cohorts, controlled ablations, and uncertainty before adding retrieval families.
strengths_to_preserve: separate ontology, SHACL, RDF, OKF, and plan authority

recommendations.title: Make answer-quality diagnosis a promotion gate
recommendations.validation: Compare claim-level retrieval coverage, entailment, unsupported claims, contradiction, context utilization, and completeness on disjoint development, validation, and holdout cohorts.

recommendations.title: Calibrate every model judge against blinded humans
recommendations.validation: Measure agreement, perturbation-specific false acceptance, and rank stability on a blinded calibration set.

recommendations.title: Replace adaptive reuse with rolling untouched cohorts
recommendations.validation: Transfer the frozen winner to new source bytes and unseen question authors without mutation.

recommendations.title: Treat chunking as an experimental factor
recommendations.validation: Freeze extractor, retriever, consultant, and questions while comparing whole-record, fixed, structural, late, and hierarchical chunking.

recommendations.title: Require simple and cross-domain retrieval baselines
recommendations.validation: Compare lexical, semantic, hybrid, and non-graph baselines on multiple domains and publish a quality-cost Pareto surface.

recommendations.title: Account for stochastic variance and practical significance
recommendations.validation: Use repeated paired runs, confidence intervals, probability of improvement, effect size, and worst-domain results.

recommendations.title: Add a reviewed claim layer above full paper text
recommendations.validation: Double-review evidence cards and measure agreement, locator validity, audit time, and claim error rate.

recommendations.title: Make corpus selection a living auditable review
recommendations.validation: Independently screen the next search delta and report agreement, exclusions, disputes, and lane saturation.

recommendations.title: Bound ontology and SHACL claims
recommendations.validation: Require competency coverage, positive and negative fixtures, per-shape runtime, and human approval for generated semantics.

recommendations.title: Evolve declarative components instead of whole copied systems
recommendations.validation: Re-express one current mutation as a sealed component contract and compare attribution, diff size, reproducibility, and quality.

recommendations.title: Add extraction-fidelity gates
recommendations.validation: Double-review a stratified page set and compare reading-order and locator error rates across extractors.

next_gate: Do not add a ninth canonical retrieval family before KM-001 through KM-006 produce selection evidence.
